storage.active_exam: PHP session file; existing resume/deadline rules retained.
storage.attempts: JSON collection in the tested release configuration; finalization retry checks inspect persisted bytes.
storage.weakness: JSON collection; learner-scoped read-modify-write is serialized.
storage.mistake_notebook: Derived from preserved attempt records; no separate history rewrite was introduced.
storage.notes: JSON collection; create request IDs and edit revisions prevent duplicate/stale overwrites.
storage.flashcard_reviews: JSON collection in the tested release configuration; request ID plus expected review count makes exact retry idempotent.
storage.question_statistics: JSON aggregate; concurrent read-modify-write operations are serialized.

fault_injection.failed_before_write: PASS; prior valid bytes and record preserved.
fault_injection.short_or_partial_temporary_write: PASS; incomplete temporary data is rejected and removed.
fault_injection.malformed_existing_json: PASS; read fails closed with StorageException and leaves bytes unchanged.
fault_injection.unreadable_storage_permissions: NOT_INJECTED; Termux/root permissions do not provide a reliable unreadable-file fixture here.
fault_injection.concurrent_collection_creates: PASS; 8 processes produced 8 unique records with no loss.
fault_injection.concurrent_learner_aggregates: PASS; 8 processes preserved each weakness and question-statistics increment.
fault_injection.concurrent_note_create_edit: PASS; 8 exact retries produced one note and one edit revision.
fault_injection.concurrent_flashcard_review: PASS; 8 exact retries produced one scheduling transition.
fault_injection.interrupted_process: NOT_INJECTED; partial write is directly injected at the write boundary.
fault_injection.power_loss_durability: NOT_CLAIMED; no fsync/power-cut guarantee was tested.

implementation: JSON writes now require a complete temporary-file write and successful same-directory replacement. The existing mutation lock remains in use; no storage migration or wholesale rewrite was added.
fixtures: Synthetic isolated temporary JSON/account fixtures; cleaned by the tests. Production learner records were not mutated.
